use default

use Action = (write: char, move: int, next: string)

class MACHINE(
    name: string,
    initial: string,
    halting: string,
    blank: char,
    rules: string[]
) is
    table: MAP[string, Action]

    init(..) is
        table = MAP[string, Action]()

        for rule in rules do
            let parts = rule.split([' '])

            let move =
                case parts[3]
                when "left" then -1
                when "right" then 1
                else 0
                esac

            table["{parts[0]} {parts[1]}"] =
                (write = parts[2][0], move = move, next = parts[4])
        od
    si

    run(input: string, show: bool) is
        let start = if input.length == 0 then "{blank}" else input fi
        let tape = LIST[char](start)
        let head mut = 0
        let state mut = initial
        let steps mut = 0L

        while state !~ halting do
            if show then
                write_line("{state,-4} {picture(tape, head)}")
            fi

            let action = table["{state} {tape[head]}"]
            tape[head] = action.write
            head = head + action.move
            state = action.next
            steps = steps + 1L

            if head < 0 then
                tape.insert(0, blank)
                head = 0
            elif head == tape.count then
                tape.add(blank)
            fi
        od

        if show then
            write_line("{state,-4} {picture(tape, head)}")
        fi

        let marked = tape |> filter(c => c != blank) |> count()
        write_line("{name}: halted after {steps} steps")
        write_line("{marked} cells marked")
        write_line()
    si
si

picture(tape: List[char], head: int) -> string =>
    (0..tape.count)
        |> map(i => if i == head then "[{tape[i]}]" else " {tape[i]} " fi)
        |> join("")

let incrementer = MACHINE(
    "simple incrementer", "q0", "qf", 'B', [
        "q0 1 1 right q0",
        "q0 B 1 stay qf"
    ])

let busy_beaver = MACHINE(
    "three-state busy beaver", "a", "halt", '0', [
        "a 0 1 right b",
        "a 1 1 left c",
        "b 0 1 left a",
        "b 1 1 right b",
        "c 0 1 left b",
        "c 1 1 stay halt"
    ])

let five_state = MACHINE(
    "five-state busy beaver", "A", "H", '0', [
        "A 0 1 right B",
        "A 1 1 left C",
        "B 0 1 right C",
        "B 1 1 right B",
        "C 0 1 right D",
        "C 1 0 left E",
        "D 0 1 left A",
        "D 1 1 left D",
        "E 0 1 stay H",
        "E 1 0 left A"
    ])

incrementer.run("111", true)
busy_beaver.run("", true)
five_state.run("", false)
